components-button.description:
Custom element: <bds-button>. React wrapper: import from blip-ds-react.

## Properties

- arrow (attribute: arrow): boolean; default: false. The arrow button

- bdsLoading (attribute: bds-loading): boolean; default: false. If true, shows the loading spinner

- bdsLoadingColor (attribute: bds-loading-color): "content" | "light" | "main" | "negative" | "positive"; default: 'main'. If not empty, Sets the color of the spinner, can be 'primary','secondary' or 'ghost'

- bdsLoadingVariant (attribute: bds-loading-variant): "delete" | "ghost" | "primary" | "secondary" | "tertiary"; default: 'primary'. If not empty, Sets the color of the spinner, can be 'primary','secondary' or 'ghost'

- block (attribute: block): boolean; default: false. If true, the base button will be disabled.

- color (attribute: color): string; default: 'primary'. 

- dataTest (attribute: data-test): string; default: null. Data test is the prop to specifically test the component action object.

- disabled (attribute: disabled): boolean; default: false. If true, the base button will be disabled.

- fullWidth (attribute: full-width): boolean; default: false. If true, the button will occupy 100% width with centered content.

- groupIcon (attribute: group-icon): boolean; default: false. If true, groups the left icon with the label when justifyContent is 'space-between'.
This keeps the left icon and text together as a single visual unit on the left side.

- icon (attribute: icon): string; default: null. used for add icon in input left. Uses the bds-icon component.

- iconLeft (attribute: icon-left): string; default: null. used for add icon in input left. Uses the bds-icon component.

- iconRight (attribute: icon-right): string; default: null. used for add icon in input left. Uses the bds-icon component.

- iconTheme (attribute: icon-theme): "outline" | "solid"; default: 'outline'. The theme of the icon. Can be one of:
'outline', 'solid';

- justifyContent (attribute: justify-content): "center" | "space-between"; default: 'center'. Controls the horizontal alignment of button content.
'center' - content is centered (default)
'space-between' - left content aligned left, right content aligned right

- size (attribute: size): "large" | "medium" | "short" | "standard" | "tall"; default: 'medium'. Size. Entered as one of the size. Can be one of:
'tall', 'standard', 'short';

- type (attribute: type): "button" | "reset" | "submit"; default: 'button'. The type of the button. Can be one of:
'button', 'submit', 'reset';

- typeIcon (attribute: type-icon): "emoji" | "icon" | "logo"; default: 'icon'. The type of the icon. Can be one of:

- variant (attribute: variant): "dashed" | "delete" | "facebook" | "ghost" | "outline" | "primary" | "secondary" | "secondary--white" | "solid" | "tertiary" | "text"; default: 'solid'. Variant. Entered as one of the variant. Can be one of:
